provenanceSearch.interpretation: Directed and non-exhaustive. No exact match in reviewed results does not prove originality, authorship, clearance or universal absence of a prior source. The search did not cover licensed databases, print-only works, deleted pages, translations, private documents, drafts or extensive paraphrase. Availability of the cited URLs does not verify the learner-facing claims; factual claim coverage and rights adjudication remain pending.

sourceAvailability.method: Direct HTTPS retrieval with redirect resolution, response-body SHA-256, content type and byte count. HTTP availability is recorded independently from claim review, authorship, licensing and rights verification.
sourceAvailability.interpretation: All sixteen requested endpoints returned HTTP 200 to this direct client at the recorded retrieval time; one Springer request resolved to a cookies-not-supported URL and is preserved as a redirect. A successful response and a body hash establish only observed availability and byte identity. They do not establish that any passage claim was reviewed or supported, nor authorship, originality, license, rights-holder authorization, endorsement or suitability for publication.

factualResearch.limitation: Cobertura dirigida y parcial. Las fuentes candidatas respaldan hotspots intraurbanos, pavimentos, sombra, estudios de viento y exposición térmica en transporte, pero no verifican todas las comparaciones de ubicación, secuencias temporales, superlativos ni relaciones causales exactas del pasaje.

Cobertura dirigida y parcial. Las fuentes candidatas respaldan pérdidas por incentivos de mercado, previsión minorista, señales para productos imperfectos, seguridad en donación y jerarquías de gestión, pero no acreditan las implementaciones, combinaciones de insumos, resultados o generalizaciones exactas del pasaje.

Cobertura dirigida y parcial. Las fuentes candidatas respaldan bibliotecas como recursos de confianza, resilience hubs, talleres con mapas, mapeo participativo e intercambio de información, pero no acreditan los concejos, Harbor Point, prácticas, resultados o ranking de valor exactos del pasaje.
